pass_a_gloss: means full assurance with proof and seal. Son is sent from Father by enfleshed presence or because Father, holding the Son within, did not hide but shone him from his nature as radiance from light; the Son has own existence while remaining in him by nature. As Spirits spring he gives it. He means Spirits energy which humans take by measure; he has the whole. Son has Spirit wholly by essence, not partly as a creature, so he gives it while saints by prayer make Christ supply Spirit through them. Father loves the world yet not as the Son, whom he loves beyond measure for natural generation as own Word wisdom and sanctification. Fulfillment comes at second coming when every knee bends after casting evil. Hand means power the Son has by nature not by share, every good essential in Father and conceived in power as Son. As man he also receives authority he had before enfleshment. Gods wrath is endless torment worse than any death. Knowing all as God he still by fitting economy acts at the right time and then seems to learn when needed. What subjects do with leaders consent while leaders watch without blocking is ascribed to leaders; after saying Jesus baptized, the text says Jesus himself did not, assigning disciples act to him in power not activity. Same pattern fits clerics sent by bishops to synods or letters. Eutyches disciples after second Ephesus again voiced his twists; he is anathematized though silent while hearing them, for disciples words return to the teacher, as Eli was blamed for enduring his sons faults. He went there to help the nations by gospel preaching before the passion.
pass_b_english: means he was fully assured and has proof and seal.

The Son is said to be sent from the Father either because of the enfleshed presence or because the Father, having the Son in himself, did not hide him but shone him forth from his own nature as “radiance” from light (Hebrews 1:3); for the Son has come out into his own existence even while he is in him by nature.

As spring of the Spirit he gives it. He means the Spirit’s activity, which humans receive by measure; for he himself has the whole complete. The Son has the whole Spirit essentially, not partly as a creature. Therefore he himself also gives it, while the saints by entreaty make Christ supply the Spirit through them.
Even if the Father loves “the world,” it is not as he loves the Son, whom he loves exceedingly because of natural generation as his own Word and wisdom and sanctification.

This is fulfilled when at the time of the second presence “every knee” bends to him (Philippians 2:10), having cast off the evil they have. Here he calls hand the power which the Son has by nature and not by participation, as every good is essentially in the Father and conceived in power as the Son. He also receives as man the authority he had before the incarnation.
Wrath of God is being in continual torments, which is harder than every death.
Even if he knows all as God, it is also of God-fitting economy to do something at the right time and then seem to learn when there is need.

Whatever subordinates do by consent of leaders who see and do not contradict or hinder, the leaders are said to do; for first saying that Jesus “baptized,” here he says that Jesus himself did not baptize, assigning the disciples’ act to him in power even if he did not do the baptism in activity. The words also fit clerics sent by bishops to synods or synodical letters or other such. Since Eutyches’ disciples who were caught about dullness after the second Ephesus synod again spoke twisted doctrines of Eutyches, Eutyches is reasonably anathematized even if he himself did not appear saying such things, as hearing his disciples speak what is not right and keeping silence; for what disciples say or do runs back to the teacher’s person. So Eli was blamed for enduring his sons’ faults as having sinned.
He came there that before the passion he might benefit the nations through the evangelical proclamation.
